questions.questionText: For which digit d is the number 4d72 divisible by 9?
questions.explanation: Digit sum = 4 + d + 7 + 2 = 18 must be a multiple of 9, so d = 5.

questions.questionText: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 8?
questions.explanation: Check the last three digits: 416 ÷ 8 = 52, exactly. The others leave non-zero remainders on their last three digits.

questions.questionText: What is the greatest 4-digit number exactly divisible by 17?
If the five-digit number 84x67 is divisible by 11, what is the digit x?
questions.explanation: Odd-place digits (1st,3rd,5th): 8 + x + 7 = 21. Even-place: 4 + 6 = 10. Difference 11 must be 0 or 11, so x = 6.

questions.questionText: How many numbers from 1 to 300 are divisible by 4 or by 6?
questions.explanation: Divisible by 4: 75; by 6: 50; by both (LCM 12): 25. Total = 75 + 50 − 25 = 100.
questions.shortcut: n(A∪B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A∩B) with the LCM.

questions.questionText: What is the least number that must be subtracted from 98765 so that it becomes divisible by 13?
questions.shortcut: Remainder is the number to subtract.

questions.questionText: The number 4x78y (a five-digit number) is divisible by 45. What is the value of x + y?
questions.explanation: Divisible by 5 means y = 0 or 5; by 9 means 4 + x + 7 + 8 + y = 19+x+y is a multiple of 9. y = 0 gives x = 8 (sum 8); y = 5 gives x = 3 (sum 8). Both give x + y = 8, so x + y = 8 either way.

questions.questionText: A six-digit number is formed by writing a three-digit number twice, such as 482482. Which of the following always divides such a number?
questions.explanation: abcabc = abc × 1001 = abc × 7 × 11 × 13. So 143 = 11 × 13 always divides it. 99, 101 and 111 do not divide every such number (e.g. 100100 is not divisible by any of them).

questions.questionText: What is the smallest five-digit number divisible by both 3 and 11?
questions.explanation: Divisible by 3 and 11 means divisible by 33. 10000 ÷ 33 leaves remainder 1, so add 32: 10032.

questions.questionText: Consider the numbers 1, 11, 111, ... up to the one with 30 digits (all digits 1). How many of them are divisible by 7?
questions.explanation: The repunit with n ones is divisible by 7 exactly when n is a multiple of 6 (111111 = 7 × 15873). Multiples of 6 up to 30: 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, i.e. 5 numbers.

questions.questionText: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 7 and also have a digit sum that is divisible by 7?
questions.explanation: Enumerating the multiples of 7 from 105 to 994 and testing their digit sums gives 18 numbers.
